description: Checks whether Managed Nerds would take on a business, from whatever is known. It is a verdict, not an estimate: preliminary_estimate gives a price range and request_full_quote reaches a person. Works with partial details. No contact details, nothing stored, no prices. Returns fit (yes, partial, ask_a_person or no), reasons, unknown (what would give a firmer answer) and the next step.

city.description: The city the business is in. With the state, it tells us whether on-site work is possible

country.description: The business's country. We only serve the US

has_it_staff.description: Whether it has its own IT person or provider. Co-managed security needs one

has_own_rmm.description: Whether it already runs its own RMM (remote monitoring and management) tool. If so, our RMM rule applies

home_office.description: True for a person working from home rather than a business office. We sometimes take these on only in our on-site area around Augusta, Georgia; give the city

platforms.description: Operating systems its computers run. Linux has extra requirements

seats.description: How many seats it would cover: computers or licensed users. Under 50 gets an estimate

service_line.description: The service the user is asking about. Defaults to co_managed (co-managed security)

state.description: US state, such as GA or SC. Implies the US if country is left out

tenant.description: Its email and identity platform: m365 (Microsoft 365) or gws (Google Workspace)

name: check_fit

outputSchema.description: Whether the buyer looks like a fit, and what to do next

unknown.description: What could not be judged from what was given

title: Check fit
